name: get_server_info
title: Get Server Info
description: Read local server identity, runtime health, and open-font count without changing Glyphs.

name: get_document_change_overview
title: Get Document Change Overview
description: Read the bounded MCP mutation overview for one tracked open Glyphs document.

name: execute_code
title: Execute Code
description: Run bounded Python in Glyphs when no dedicated tool fits; this can change fonts or external state.

name: execute_code_with_context
title: Execute Code With Context
description: Run bounded Python with an explicit font and glyph context when dedicated tools are insufficient.

name: docs_search
title: Docs Search
description: Search the bundled official Glyphs API, plug-in, and file-format documentation without changing state.

name: docs_get
title: Docs Get
description: Fetch one bundled Glyphs documentation page by its exact result ID or path.

name: list_open_fonts
title: List Open Fonts
description: List every font currently open in Glyphs and return stable font indices for later calls.

name: get_font_glyphs
title: Get Font Glyphs
description: List bounded glyph metadata for one explicit open font without changing it.

name: get_font_masters
title: Get Font Masters
description: Read masters, IDs, design metrics, and italic angles for one explicit open font.

name: set_master_italic_angle
title: Set Master Italic Angle
description: Dry-run or set one master's Glyphs italicAngle after explicit confirmation; never saves.

name: get_font_instances
title: Get Font Instances
description: Read instance metadata for one explicit open font without changing it.

name: get_glyph_details
title: Get Glyph Details
description: Inspect one glyph's layers, metrics, shapes, anchors, components, and compatibility metadata.

name: get_font_kerning
title: Get Font Kerning
description: Read bounded kerning data for one explicit font and master without changing it.

name: get_selected_glyphs
title: Get Selected Glyphs
description: Read the current Glyphs font-view selection and return exact glyph targets and links.

name: get_selected_font_and_master
title: Get Selected Font And Master
description: Read the active font, master, and selection context from Glyphs without changing it.

name: get_selected_nodes
title: Get Selected Nodes
description: Read selected Edit View nodes with glyph, layer, path, node, and master mapping.

name: get_litsquare_metadata
title: Get LitSquare Metadata
description: Read direct LitSquare metadata, validation states, provenance, and effective settings for an explicit target.

name: get_selected_litsquare_path_roles
title: Get Selected LitSquare Path Roles
description: Read selected LitSquare path roles with stable targets, counts, descriptions, and individual bounds.

name: get_icon_grid_horizontal_center
title: Get Icon Grid Horizontal Center
description: Read one layer's fixed IconGrid center plus advance and layer-content position candidates.

name: patch_litsquare_metadata
title: Patch LitSquare Metadata
description: Dry-run or confirm an RFC 7396 patch to one LitSquare metadata scope; preserves unknown data and never saves.

name: set_litsquare_path_roles
title: Set LitSquare Path Roles
description: Dry-run or atomically confirm open-string LitSquare roles on fingerprinted paths; preserves other attributes and never saves.

name: set_icon_grid_horizontal_center
title: Set Icon Grid Horizontal Center
description: Dry-run or store one explicit fixed IconGrid x-coordinate on a layer; never edits artwork or saves.

name: reset_icon_grid_horizontal_center
title: Reset Icon Grid Horizontal Center
description: Dry-run or remove only one layer's namespaced IconGrid center policy while preserving unrelated data.

name: get_glyph_paths
title: Get Glyph Paths
description: Read editable path data for one glyph and master in a bounded round-trip-safe format.

name: review_start_node_alignment
title: Review Start Node Alignment
description: Review one semantic start-node landmark as a joint cyclic phase across explicit compatible masters.

name: apply_start_node_alignment
title: Apply Start Node Alignment
description: Dry-run or atomically apply one fingerprint-bound joint start-node alignment after confirmation; never saves.

name: update_glyph_node_positions
title: Update Glyph Node Positions
description: Dry-run or atomically update explicit node coordinates on one glyph layer using the font grid by default.

name: set_glyph_paths
title: Set Glyph Paths
description: Replace paths on one explicit glyph layer after validation; preserves surrounding shapes and never saves.

name: get_glyph_components
title: Get Glyph Components
description: Inspect component identities, transforms, smart values, and target layers for one glyph.

name: add_component_to_glyph
title: Add Component To Glyph
description: Add one component to an explicit glyph layer after validating its target.

name: add_anchor_to_glyph
title: Add Anchor To Glyph
description: Add one anchor at explicit coordinates on one targeted glyph layer.

name: add_corner_to_all_masters
title: Add Corner To All Masters
description: Add one corner hint at selected compatible nodes across explicit masters.

name: create_glyph
title: Create Glyph
description: Create one named glyph in an explicit open font; does not save the document.

name: delete_glyph
title: Delete Glyph
description: Delete one named glyph from an explicit open font; use only after confirming references.

name: update_glyph_properties
title: Update Glyph Properties
description: Update explicit glyph metadata fields without changing unrelated properties or saving.

name: copy_glyph
title: Copy Glyph
description: Copy outline data from one explicit glyph to another after validating the destination.

name: update_glyph_metrics
title: Update Glyph Metrics
description: Update width or sidebearings on one explicit glyph and master without saving.

name: save_font
title: Save Font
description: Save one explicit open font to its current path or an explicit new path.

name: get_custom_parameters
title: Get Custom Parameters
description: Read generic font or master custom parameters without changing the document.

name: set_custom_parameters
title: Set Custom Parameters
description: Dry-run or atomically set explicit custom parameters after confirmation; never saves.

name: list_style_sets
title: List Style Sets
description: List OpenType stylistic sets, substitutions, and direct Glyphs review links without mutation.

name: set_kerning_pair
title: Set Kerning Pair
description: Set or remove one explicit kerning pair in one master; does not save the font.

name: generate_kerning_tab
title: Generate Kerning Tab
description: Open a bounded kerning proof tab in Glyphs for interactive review.

name: review_kerning_bumper
title: Review Kerning Bumper
description: Measure bounded kerning collisions and propose conservative exceptions without mutation.

name: apply_kerning_bumper
title: Apply Kerning Bumper
description: Dry-run or apply explicit reviewed kerning exceptions after confirmation; never saves.

name: set_spacing_guides
title: Set Spacing Guides
description: Add or clear only Glyphs MCP spacing guides on explicit glyph layers.

name: review_spacing
title: Review Spacing
description: Measure and propose class-aware spacing for explicit glyphs without changing the font.

name: apply_spacing
title: Apply Spacing
description: Dry-run or apply reviewed spacing to explicit glyphs after confirmation; never saves.

name: set_spacing_params
title: Set Spacing Params
description: Dry-run or set spacing custom parameters for one font or master without saving.

name: review_master_stem_metrics
title: Review Master Stem Metrics
description: Review master stem metrics required by italic construction without changing the font.

name: set_master_stem_metrics
title: Set Master Stem Metrics
description: Dry-run or set explicit master stem metrics after confirmation; never saves.

name: review_unicode_assignments
title: Review Unicode Assignments
description: Review Unicode mappings and deterministic allocation proposals without changing glyphs.

name: apply_unicode_assignments
title: Apply Unicode Assignments
description: Dry-run or atomically apply explicit Unicode mappings after collision checks.

name: review_tunni_geometry
title: Review Tunni Geometry
description: Measure grid-safe Tunni balance for explicit cubic path segments without changing the font.

name: apply_tunni_balance
title: Apply Tunni Balance
description: Dry-run or balance explicit cubic handles after confirmation and exact read-back verification.

name: review_curve_quality
title: Review Curve Quality
description: Measure adaptive cubic events, curvature, continuity, and warnings on one explicit raw path.

name: review_curve_quality_across_masters
title: Review Curve Quality Across Masters
description: Compare compatible cubic geometry and quality measurements across explicit masters.

name: set_curve_review_overlay
title: Set Curve Review Overlay
description: Show or hide native curvature and curve-event overlays in Glyphs Edit View.

name: get_curve_review_overlay_state
title: Get Curve Review Overlay State
description: Read bounded native curve Reporter state for the embedded Glyphs app.

name: apply_collinear_handles_smooth
title: Apply Collinear Handles Smooth
description: Dry-run or mark explicit collinear curve nodes smooth after confirmation.

name: preview_tunni_balance_candidate
title: Preview Tunni Balance Candidate
description: Create a detached multi-target Tunni candidate and show only its visual difference.

name: preview_collinear_handles_candidate
title: Preview Collinear Handles Candidate
description: Create a detached smooth-node candidate for explicit path and node targets.

name: preview_compensated_tuning_candidate
title: Preview Compensated Tuning Candidate
description: Create detached compensated-tuning candidates for explicit glyphs and masters.

name: preview_italic_first_pass_candidate
title: Preview Italic First Pass Candidate
description: Create a detached Roman-to-italic construction draft for guarded visual review.

name: set_outline_candidate_overlay
title: Set Outline Candidate Overlay
description: Show, hide, switch, or clear ephemeral candidate Reporter state without editing fonts.

name: get_outline_candidate_state
title: Get Outline Candidate State
description: Read bounded ephemeral and materialized candidate-session state without mutation.

name: materialize_outline_candidate_session
title: Materialize Outline Candidate Session
description: Dry-run or create editable candidate layers for one reviewed session.

name: review_outline_candidate_session
title: Review Outline Candidate Session
description: Revalidate a candidate against its live source and issue a fingerprint-bound token.

name: accept_outline_candidate_session
title: Accept Outline Candidate Session
description: Dry-run or promote only the exact reviewed candidate fields after confirmation.

name: discard_outline_candidate_session
title: Discard Outline Candidate Session
description: Dry-run or delete only materialized layers owned by one candidate session.

name: get_glyph_annotations
title: Get Glyph Annotations
description: Read native annotations and Glyphs MCP ownership metadata for one explicit glyph layer.

name: add_glyph_annotation
title: Add Glyph Annotation
description: Add one native annotation to an explicit layer and record Glyphs MCP ownership.

name: add_glyph_annotation_group
title: Add Glyph Annotation Group
description: Add a linked group of native annotations to one explicit glyph layer.

name: update_glyph_annotation
title: Update Glyph Annotation
description: Update one explicitly identified native annotation without touching unrelated items.

name: delete_glyph_annotation
title: Delete Glyph Annotation
description: Delete one explicitly identified native annotation from one glyph layer.

name: clear_glyph_annotations
title: Clear Glyph Annotations
description: Clear managed annotations by default, or all annotations only with explicit scope.

name: get_glyph_annotation_groups
title: Get Glyph Annotation Groups
description: Read Glyphs MCP-managed annotation groups for one explicit glyph layer.

name: ExportDesignspaceAndUFO
title: Export Designspace and UFO
description: Export designspace and UFO packages for one selected font to an explicit directory.

name: show_glyphs_status
title: Show Glyphs Status
description: Show local server, Glyphs, and open-font status in the embedded feedback panel.

name: show_font_feedback
title: Show Font Feedback
description: Show read-only information for one open font in the embedded feedback panel.

name: show_glyph_feedback
title: Show Glyph Feedback
description: Show read-only glyph metadata in the embedded feedback panel.

name: show_opentype_features
title: Show OpenType Features
description: Show a read-only OpenType feature report in the embedded feedback panel.

name: preview_spacing_feedback
title: Preview Spacing Feedback
description: Preview an exact spacing plan in the embedded feedback panel without mutation.

name: preview_kerning_feedback
title: Preview Kerning Feedback
description: Preview an exact kerning plan in the embedded feedback panel without mutation.

name: preview_handle_smoothing_feedback
title: Preview Handle Smoothing Feedback
description: Preview an exact handle-smoothing plan in the embedded feedback panel.

name: apply_feedback_plan
title: Apply Feedback Plan
description: Apply one unexpired embedded feedback plan after explicit app confirmation.

name: open_feedback_target
title: Open Feedback Target
description: Open resolved glyph targets from an embedded feedback result in a new Glyphs tab.
